# type(scope): short imperative summary (<=72 chars, lowercase subject)
#
# Allowed types: build, chore, ci, docs, feat, fix, perf, refactor,
#                revert, style, test
#
# Body (optional, separated from subject by a blank line):
# - What changed
# - Why it changed
# - Any trade-offs or follow-ups
#
# Footer (REQUIRED — separated from body by a blank line):
# - Must include exactly one Linear magic-word line, e.g.:
#     Completes DUB-1
#     Fixes DUB-12, DUB-34
#   Magic words: Close[s|d], Fix[es|ed], Resolve[s|d], Complete[s|d],
#                Implement[s|ed], Ref[s], References, Part of, Contributes to
# - Optional trailers (one per line): BREAKING CHANGE: <details>, Co-authored-by: ...

type(scope): summary

Completes DUB-
